name: orion
description: Browse, cite, and write to your local Orion knowledge Spaces from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Your local knowledge atlas, available in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Bring Orion's structured, local knowledge atlas into Codex. Discover Spaces, orient with living overviews, search and open evidence-bearing notes and sources, follow native Orion citations, and create, update, or delete notes when you ask—without cloud sync or connector path setup.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my active Orion Space with citations.
Find what Orion says about this topic and cite the notes.
Create a note in my Orion Space from this conversation.
